name: Holz Wood Shop
old_description: “Quality is just a word, and an empty word at that, if it doesn’t include harmony, balance, passion, intention, attention.”
about:
Holz Wood Shop operates from Miami, Florida, as a design and custom fabrication company specializing in fine furniture. The shop builds engineered pieces tailored to client specifications, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces custom furniture for residential and hospitality settings, including tables, bars, retail counters, shelving, and live-edge wood pieces. Its capabilities span CNC fabrication, traditional joinery, and full design services such as 3D renderings, shop drawings, and conceptual design packages. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Clients range from high-end residential customers seeking one-of-a-kind dining sets, desks, and bedroom furniture to hospitality operators needing bar installations, restaurant decor, and retail display fixtures. Project examples include a solid walnut gaming table, a custom kitchen island with a white oak top, a Baltic birch dining set with mortise-and-tenon joints, and built-in children’s room furniture.

Holz Wood Shop emphasizes traditional craftsmanship, the use of premium natural materials, and collaboration with local suppliers and artists to create unique, clean, high-quality pieces. The firm also offers proprietary product development and design consulting alongside fabrication.
